title: Glowing train
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- track -->
  <rect x="5" y="82" width="90" height="4" rx="2" fill="#5b4a8a"/>
  <rect x="10" y="86" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#8a7ac0"/>
  <rect x="28" y="86" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#8a7ac0"/>
  <rect x="46" y="86" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#8a7ac0"/>
  <rect x="64" y="86" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#8a7ac0"/>
  <rect x="82" y="86" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#8a7ac0"/>

  <!-- engine body (front, facing right) -->
  <rect x="12" y="52" width="46" height="28" rx="5" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  <!-- engine lighter shade for top edge -->
  <rect x="12" y="52" width="46" height="6" rx="3" fill="#ff9a9a"/>

  <!-- cab window -->
  <rect x="20" y="58" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <rect x="22" y="60" width="4" height="4" rx="1" fill="#fff3b0"/>

  <!-- boiler stripe -->
  <rect x="14" y="72" width="42" height="4" rx="2" fill="#cc4444"/>

  <!-- smokestack -->
  <rect x="44" y="42" width="8" height="12" rx="2" fill="#ff8c42"/>
  <rect x="42" y="40" width="12" height="5" rx="2" fill="#ffb366"/>

  <!-- smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="32" r="5" fill="#b8c1ec"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="24" r="4" fill="#ccd3f5"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="24" r="3" fill="#ccd3f5"/>

  <!-- front cowcatcher -->
  <polygon points="58,52 66,80 58,80" fill="#ff8c42"/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx="60" cy="64" r="5" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="64" r="2.5" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- glow rays from headlight -->
  <line x1="66" y1="64" x2="74" y2="64" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="65" y1="59" x2="71" y2="55" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="65" y1="69" x2="71" y2="73" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="82" r="6" fill="#4a3a7a" stroke="#8a7ac0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="82" r="2" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="82" r="6" fill="#4a3a7a" stroke="#8a7ac0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="82" r="2" fill="#ff6b6b"/>

  <!-- coupling to carriage -->
  <rect x="58" y="74" width="6" height="4" rx="1" fill="#8a7ac0"/>

  <!-- carriage -->
  <rect x="64" y="58" width="30" height="22" rx="4" fill="#5bc0eb"/>
  <rect x="64" y="58" width="30" height="5" rx="2" fill="#8fd8f5"/>

  <!-- carriage windows -->
  <rect x="68" y="65" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <rect x="79" y="65" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <rect x="90" y="65" width="3" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#ffe066"/>

  <!-- carriage stripe -->
  <rect x="66" y="75" width="26" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#3a9fc8"/>

  <!-- carriage wheels -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="82" r="5" fill="#4a3a7a" stroke="#8a7ac0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="82" r="1.8" fill="#5bc0eb"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="82" r="5" fill="#4a3a7a" stroke="#8a7ac0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="82" r="1.8" fill="#5bc0eb"/>
</svg>
